what: The problem: storing many CT versions compactly
title: Validity-Date Versioning Design
text: CDISC Controlled Terminology released quarterly. release contains roughly 45,000 rows. Storing every version separate file mean 45,000 × 40+ releases ≈ 1.8 million rows significant duplication, since terms change releases.

title: Validity-Date Versioning Design
text: cdiscdata uses validity-date design. row represents unique term-state: set values term given point time. term’s content changes releases: 1. old row closed setting valid_to = new_release_date - 1. 2. new row added valid_from = new_release_date valid_to = NA. term retired: - current row closed valid_to = retirement_date - 1. - new row added.

title: Validity-Date Versioning Design
text: get_ct() get_dataset() filter table rows valid requested date: query date must exactly match one release dates returned available_ct_versions(). ensures reproducibility: version string always returns rows.
code: # Rows where valid_from <= query_date AND (valid_to >= query_date OR valid_to is NA) tbl[tbl$valid_from <= query_date &       (is.na(tbl$valid_to) | tbl$valid_to >= query_date), ]

title: Validity-Date Versioning Design
text: terms stable across releases, small fraction rows change per quarter (~1,000–1,500 new rows per release vs. 45,000+ total terms). full historical archive therefore grows slowly, keeping package size manageable CRAN submission.

title: Validity-Date Versioning Design
code: # How many rows represent "closed" (historical) term states? n_closed  <- sum(!is.na(ct_sdtm$valid_to)) n_current <- sum(is.na(ct_sdtm$valid_to)) cat("Current rows:", n_current, "\nHistorical rows:", n_closed, "\n") #> Current rows: 47242  #> Historical rows: 77625

title: Versioned CDISC Standards Reference Data
text: cdiscdata provides versioned CDISC reference data standard R package, zero runtime dependencies. bundles: Controlled Terminology (CT): historical SDTM ADaM CT releases NCI EVS FTP site, stored compactly using validity-date design (one row per term-state, one copy per release). Current 2026-09-25 NCI release. Implementation-guide, model, CDASH, QRS variable metadata: variables 34 SDTM-, SEND-, ADaM-side guides (SDTM model; SDTMIG 3.1.2 3.4, -AP, -MD; SENDIG 3.0 3.1.1, -AR, -DART, -GeneTox; ADaMIG 1.0 1.3, -MD, -NCA, ADaM-ADAE, -BDS-TTE, -OCCDS, -popPK), CDASH model CDASHIG, items nine QRS instrument supplements, every version. See get_ig(), get_cdash(), build_domain_spec(). Define-XML XSD schemas: validating define.xml files (versions 2.0 2.1). XSLT stylesheets: rendering define.xml HTML (versions 2.0 2.1). CT, Define-XML schemas, XSLT stylesheets sourced exclusively publicly available, license-free sources, CDISC Library API key needed. IG, model, CDASH, QRS metadata transcribed CDISC Library CSV exports downloaded CDISC’s terms conditions. exports repository redistributed; variable metadata carried, guides’ prose. See Data sources data-raw/README.md.

title: Versioned CDISC Standards Reference Data
text: validity-date design means historical data stored without duplication: row carries valid_from date valid_to date (NA = still current). get_ct() reconstructs state release fly.
code: # Latest SDTM CT (all codelists and terms as a data frame) ct <- get_ct("sdtm") nrow(ct) head(ct[, c("codelist_code", "codelist_name", "term", "decoded_value")])  # All available CT release dates, most recent first versions <- available_ct_versions("sdtm") head(versions)  # CT as it existed at a specific historical release ct_prev <- get_ct("sdtm", version = versions[[2]])  # ADaM CT works the same way ct_adam <- get_ct("adam")

title: Versioned CDISC Standards Reference Data
text: Every standard version bundled, export built : ig_sources lists export, parsed standard version, row count, checksum.
code: # The newest SDTMIG (3.4), every domain get_ig()  # One standard, one version, one domain get_ig("SDTMIG", version = "3.3", domain = "PP") get_ig("SENDIG", domain = "PP")  # The SDTM model, and the ADaM guides and their extensions get_ig("SDTM", version = "2.1", domain = "Findings") get_ig("ADaMIG", domain = "BDS") get_ig("ADaMIG-NCA")  # The CDASH model and implementation guide get_cdash() get_cdash("CDASHIG", version = "2.1", domain = "LB")  # A ready-to-use variable spec (name, label, type, core, order, source, # codelist id) for PP, SUPPPP, or ADPP, joined to CT for codelist ids build_domain_spec("PP") build_domain_spec("SUPPPP") build_domain_spec("ADPP")                       # ADaMIG BDS + ADSL build_domain_spec("ADPP", extension = "NCA")    # ... + ADaMIG-NCA

title: Build a variable specification for PP, SUPPPP, or ADPP — build_domain_spec
text: Combines get_ig (variable name, label, type, core, order, codelist) get_ct (codelist controlled terminology release) single, ready--use variable specification one three PK datasets. PP SUPPPP draw SDTM-side implementation guide (SUPPPP generic SUPP– structure, since CDISC domain-specific SUPPPP table); ADPP draws ADaMIG Basic Data Structure (BDS) table, since ADPP BDS dataset CDISC ADPP-specific table either. ADPP spec can optionally unioned ADaMIG ADSL table (adsl), BDS extension ADaMIG-NCA (extension), SDTM PP domain's variables (sdtm_domain).

title: Build a variable specification for PP, SUPPPP, or ADPP — build_domain_spec
code: build_domain_spec(   domain = c("PP", "SUPPPP", "ADPP"),   ig_version = NULL,   ct_version = NULL,   adsl = TRUE,   sdtm_domain = NULL,   sdtmig_version = NULL,   standard = NULL,   extension = NULL,   extension_version = NULL )

title: Build a variable specification for PP, SUPPPP, or ADPP — build_domain_spec
text: domain One "PP", "SUPPPP", "ADPP". ig_version Version standard use. NULL uses newest available. ct_version CT version check codelist ids ; passed get_ct. NULL uses newest available. adsl domain = "ADPP" : whether union ADaMIG ADSL variables (default TRUE), since real ADPP dataset carries ADSL's subject-level variables (treatment, demographics, ...) alongside BDS variables. FALSE returns BDS variables alone. Ignored (warning) domain != "ADPP". sdtm_domain domain = "ADPP" : NULL (default) adds nothing; "PP" also unions SDTMIG PP domain's variables, way adsl = TRUE unions ADSL's: marked source = "SDTMIG", core forced "Perm", variable already defined keeping version, codelist ids checked ADaM CT first SDTM CT second. Ignored (warning) domain != "ADPP"; value "PP" error. sdtmig_version SDTMIG version take sdtm_domain variables . NULL uses newest available. Ignored (warning) unless domain = "ADPP" sdtm_domain set. standard implementation guide take domain's variables . NULL (default) uses "SDTMIG" PP SUPPPP "ADaMIG" ADPP; standard get_ig domain works (e.g. "SENDIG" defines PP ). extension domain = "ADPP" : NULL (default) adds nothing; "ADaMIG-NCA" (alias "NCA"), "ADaM-popPK", "ADaM-BDS-TTE" unions BDS extension onto BDS variables. Unlike ADSL PP unions, extension's Core designations kept, point extension: new variable appended published Core, variable BDS already defines takes extension's (stronger) Core (e.g. AVISIT becomes required ADaMIG-NCA). Rows extension touches marked name source. Ignored (warning) domain != "ADPP". extension_version Version extension; NULL uses newest. Ignored (warning) unless domain = "ADPP" extension set.

title: CDASH model variable metadata — cdash_model
text: One row per variable CDISC Clinical Data Acquisition Standards Harmonization (CDASH) model, every version: 1.0, 1.1, 1.2, 1.3. Built CDISC Library CSV exports redistributed package (see ig_sources); variable metadata collection wording (question text, prompt) carried, model's definitions, mapping instructions, implementation notes. Retrieve get_cdash("CDASH").

title: CDASH model variable metadata — cdash_model
text: data frame columns: standard Always "CDASH". version Model version, e.g. "1.3". class Observation special-purpose class, e.g.     "Findings", "Identifiers". domain domain domain-specific variable belongs (e.g.     "AE"), NA class-level variables. order Position within class domain, published. variable CDASH variable name, e.g. "--TERM". label Variable label. 40 characters except 6 labels     model publishes longer (--TESTCD 1.0 1.1;     --ENDATF four versions). domain_specific TRUE model flags variable     domain specific; NA say. question_text CRF question text model suggests. prompt CRF field prompt model suggests. type "Char" "Num". sdtm_target SDTM variable variables collected value     maps . codelist_code CDISC CT codelist C-code variable uses;     NA none.

title: Retrieve any cdiscdata dataset by name and version — get_dataset
text: Generic retrieval gateway. CT datasets, filters rows valid requested version date. implementation-guide, model, CDASH, QRS datasets (ig_sdtm, model_sdtm, ig_adam, cdash_model, ig_cdash, qrs_supplement), returns whole table, rows whose version column equals version (across every standard instrument ; use get_ig get_cdash pick one standard). schemas stylesheets, returns file path requested Define-XML version. Use list_datasets see available dataset names.

title: cdiscdata 0.2.0
text: Fixed get_ct(), get_dataset(), list_datasets(), cdiscdata_versions(), available_ct_versions() work via cdiscdata:: alone, without library(cdiscdata) first. Lazy-loaded package data (ct_sdtm, ct_adam, ig_sdtm, ig_adam, datasets_catalogue) wired search path package attached; loading just namespace (:: ) left unqualified reference data unresolved, even inside package’s functions - e.g. cdiscdata::get_ct("sdtm") without prior library() call errored object 'datasets_catalogue' found. Fixed via internal .pkg_data() helper loads dataset explicitly utils::data(), independent attach state. Verified dedicated test (tests/testthat/test-attach.R) builds installs package fresh library calls via callr::r() brand-new subprocess library() call.

title: cdiscdata 0.2.0
text: Added ig_sdtm: SDTM Model Findings general-observation-class variables (versions 1.4-1.7), plus SDTMIG PP domain generic SUPP– qualifier structure (version 3.2 - see data-raw/ig_source/README.md newer SDTMIG version’s PP/SUPP– tables available source). Added ig_adam: ADaMIG ADSL (subject-level) BDS (Basic Data Structure, used ADPP) variable tables, versions 1.0, 1.1, 1.2. Added get_ig(standard, version), mirroring get_ct(). Added build_domain_spec(domain, ig_version, ct_version, adsl), returning ready--use variable spec (name, label, type, length, core, order, source, codelist id) "PP", "SUPPPP" (via generic SUPP– structure), "ADPP" (via generic BDS structure, joined CT codelist ids). "ADPP", adsl = TRUE (default) also unions ADaMIG ADSL variables - real ADPP carries ADSL’s subject-level variables alongside BDS variables - marked source = "ADSL" core = "Perm" (ADSL’s Core reflects requirements ADSL , merging variable ADPP, always optional); variable defined tables (e.g. STUDYID, USUBJID) keeps BDS version rather duplicated. adsl = FALSE returns BDS variables alone, . Neither table carries PP’s variables (PPTESTCD rest) forward ADPP; remains downstream derivation choice, IG metadata function sources. get_ig()/ig_sdtm’s SDTMIG-3.2-coverage PP domain SUPP– structure now called explicitly get_ig()’s documentation, including specific known gaps versus newer SDTMIG (PPANMETH, EPOCH, PTAETORD yet added; SDTMIG 3.2 still PPDTC, later PPPDTC rename). IG metadata transcribed CDISC’s published SDTM Model/SDTMIG/ADaMIG specification tables, copied read-(attribution) Bill Denney’s private Rsdtm package - see data-raw/ig_source/README.md. supersedes package’s original plan leave IG metadata separate cdiscapi package; README updated accordingly.

title: cdiscdata 0.1.0
text: First release cdiscdata. Bundles versioned CDISC SDTM ADaM Controlled Terminology NCI EVS FTP site using compact validity-date design. Includes Define-XML XSD schemas (2.0, 2.1) XSLT stylesheets. Key functions: get_ct(), get_dataset(), available_ct_versions(), schema_path(), stylesheet_path(), list_datasets(), cdiscdata_versions().
